nodes.title: The product runtime's ears for the curated cascade stacks (v2-flashlite, v2-54mini, v2-38flash, v2-mai, v2-luna) are Azure Speech real-time STT (hi-IN, Central India, LAB_SPEECH_KEY/REGION) through the VAD gate, ported from the lab's measured AzureSTT via the Speech SDK (azure-cognitiveservices-speech 1.52.0). Gemini ears stay in the catalog, unavailable with "Gemini listening isn't offered on Google Cloud"; never rerouted
nodes.rationale: decision.2026-10-22.ears-azure-not-gemini: Vertex has no Gemini transcription model (measure.2026-10-22.vertex-availability-probe). The SDK path is what the lab runs and measured; a hand-rolled websocket protocol would be new, unmeasured code on the hottest path.
nodes.reverse_if: Vertex offers a Gemini transcription model and it beats Azure on Hinglish accuracy or latency in the lab; or the Speech SDK cannot run in the deploy image (then the REST/websocket protocol or Sarvam ears)

nodes.title: The product runtime does not offer gpt-oss-120b@groq: gpt-oss-120b runs on our Azure Foundry (routing Vertex > Foundry > OpenRouter). The cost is first-token latency: Groq 0.48 s against Azure 1.47 s (n=6, India VM, 2026-10-19, tests/brain_bench.py)
nodes.rationale: directive.2026-10-22.provider-routing: OpenRouter only for what is in neither Vertex nor our Foundry.
nodes.reverse_if: the owner judges the extra ~1 s of first-token latency worth an OpenRouter route for gpt-oss-120b
